P. (लिनाति) 
__1 To adhere. 
__2 To melt, usually with वि. -

Ā. (लीयते, लीन) 
__1 To stick or adhere firmly to, cling to. 
__2 To clasp, embrace. 
__3 To lie or rest on, recline, stay or dwell in, lurk, hide, cower down; (भृङ्गाङ्गनाः) लीयन्ते मुकुलान्तरेषु शनकैः संजातलज्जा इव [[

.]] 
__4 To be dissolved, melt away. 
__5 To be sticky or viscous. 
__6 To be absorbed in, be devoted or attached to; माधब मनसिजविशिखभयादिव भाबनया त्वयि लीना [[

.]] 
__7 To vanish, disappear. -Caus. (लापयति-ते, लाययति-ते, लीनयति-ते, लालयति-ते) To melt, dissolve, liquefy. (The form लापयते is used in the sense of ‘to honour’, ‘cause to be honoured’; जटाभिर्लापयते = पूजामधिगच्छति; cf. [[
